name: Baku Museum of Modern Art
funding: Opened 20 Mar 2009 with about 800 works; founded by First Lady Mehriban Aliyeva and funded by the Heydar Aliyev Foundation, which she heads.

name: Heydar Aliyev Center
funding: A US$250M Azerbaijani state project opened in 2012; its main contractor was tied to the Aliyev family's offshore network.

name: Military Trophy Park
funding: Azerbaijani state project. President Ilham Aliyev ordered it built in January 2021 and opened it on 12 April 2021, according to the presidential website.

name: National Art Gallery of The Bahamas
funding: Non-profit with a government subvention plus private donors, memberships and admissions.

name: Bangladesh Shilpakala Academy
funding: Statutory body under the Ministry of Cultural Affairs, founded in 1974, governed by a minister-led Executive Council. It runs district branches, scholarships and the National Art Gallery.

name: Bengal Foundation
funding: Private trust founded in 1986, funded entirely by the Bengal Group. Chairman Abul Khair Litu co-founded AB Bank. It runs a fine arts gallery, a music festival and publishing.

name: Britto Arts Trust
funding: Its site names partners including Ford Foundation, Prince Claus Fund, Bengal Foundation, British Council and Goethe-Institut Dhaka.

name: Dhaka Art Summit
funding: The producing Samdani Art Foundation is privately funded by Nadia and Rajeeb Samdani. Golden Harvest's sponsorship of the summit paid for promotional banners.

name: Barbados Museum and Historical Society
funding: Annual Government of Barbados grant, plus memberships, gate takings, shop sales, ground rentals and consulting fees. The government appoints five of its 14 council members.

name: Fresh Milk Art Platform
funding: Mellon Foundation unrestricted grant of US$350,000 over 2024 to 2026, plus restricted grants of BBD 150,000 in 2024. Runs the FM/CLF fellowship with the Clara Lionel Foundation.
